input.overview: For {duration}, io-shop's account pages failed to load for shoppers who had not bought anything so far this month. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests failed. The cause was a software update that removed a safeguard for these shoppers. A new account-page feature was switched on at the same moment, and without the safeguard, the page's monthly spending calculation failed for them. Argus estimates the lost sales at {customer_loss}. Nobody was paged, and no on-call incident was linked to this one. Argus tried to roll back the io-shop software update, but it couldn't reach the platform, so nothing was changed. Argus then switched off the new monthly spending feature (the feature flag monthly-spend-feature). That change is confirmed and still in place. Argus has also proposed a permanent fix, PR #568, which is still a draft and has not been applied.
